title: Ventilation air for fuel burning devices.
officialText:
Where ventilation air is brought in by mechanical means for heat generation
mitigation, provisions must be made for proper air balance to prevent a negative or positive pressure in the boiler room and to discharge
the ventilation directly to the outside.
